changes_from_r4: Resolve accessible signed app groups independently of the signed app identifier
Skip native widget image writes and directory creation when their path is unavailable
Increment app and four extension build numbers; retain BYD display name
packaging: Re-signable IPA with original app and extension identifiers and app-group entitlements. Keep all four app extensions when signing. No personal provisioning profile or device data.
validation: Focused regression tests reproduce the nil-path NSData exception and verify both image writers, signed-group variants, storage recovery and unchanged native-save inputs/bytes on macOS and in an iOS 16.7.16 laboratory harness. A separate iOS harness loads the complete production module and confirms its constructor installs the guards even without app-group entitlements. Package checks preserve every R4 entry except five widget modules and five build-number plists. The exact R5 app has not yet been installed or launched on a non-jailbroken device; fixes are not yet confirmed by the issue reporters or on iOS 27 beta.
known_issue: Inconsistent RSSI on one iPhone XS persists after iOS 18.7.10; an unintended indoor unlock was reported during earlier testing. Hardware cause is not established. Disable walk-up unlock if readings overlap between intended near and far positions or unintended actions occur.
installation_report_status: Issue 5 shows an iOS installation failure; no installer diagnostic establishes its cause or a connection to the runtime image-storage crash.
